Sealed trajectories-v1 at benchmarks/flashalign/local-results/hfq-diagnostics-20261014/trajectories-v1. Numerical source identity c6958633836fb428ec82d2b128007816967699c567a0c7169300718a48145e50; copied compiled runtime and immutable input/source manifests are verified before execution. The first OASIS 11-to-12 selected-control replay is running under a 6 GiB heap, one active Java processor and a one-hour diagnostic deadline. Initial captured checkpoint export succeeded; final real-image neutrality is not yet known. No panel expansion or checkpoint scoring has occurred.

Prepared and separately sealed checkpoint-analysis-v1 before scoring any checkpoint. It reads completed captured runs, stages only map-input symlinks into a separate analysis tree, preserves native export status, runs the fixed-region intensity audit, common geometry/cell/anatomy evaluation, and records every uncaptured/unavailable/failed event. Added a physical residual-displacement gradient norm with explicit valid-stencil counts on original midpoint grids. Two analytic tests establish exact derivatives on an oblique anisotropic lattice and translation/invalid-stencil behavior; all six diagnostic Python tests pass. Geometry errors and missing states remain visible, and labels are restricted to post-hoc diagnosis. Per-structure trajectory plots and mechanism analysis remain outstanding.
